**PotentialPunch 1.4.0**

- FX chain presets: 90s Stab, Break Bus and Dub Drums. Pick the same name in PotentialPatina, PotentialGrit and PotentialBleed to load the whole chain (see the PotentialSuite page).
- The PRESETS buttons are now three rows, to make room.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialPunch-1.4.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpunch/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialPunch-1.4.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialPunch-1.4.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialPunch-1.4.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpunch/issues/new/choose).
